AIExplanation.description: Output of an explanation model (e.g. Gemini, M7). Stored separately; never an observation.
AIExplanation.title: AIExplanation

analyzed_qualities.description: Quality values included in statistics. Others are excluded and counted, never dropped.
analyzed_qualities.title: Analyzed Qualities

expected_interval_s.description: Expected sampling interval per metric id (seconds). Missing => inferred from the series' median spacing and labelled 'inferred'.
expected_interval_s.title: Expected Interval S

expected_metrics.description: Metric ids every subject is expected to have; absences are reported.
expected_metrics.title: Expected Metrics

include_point_deviations.description: Return one deviation row per post-baseline observation.
include_point_deviations.title: Include Point Deviations

modified_z_cutoff.description: Statistical outlier cutoff on |modified z| (Iglewicz & Hoaglin 1993 convention). Not a clinical threshold.
modified_z_cutoff.title: Modified Z Cutoff

notice.default: Statistical description only. Not a diagnosis, not medical advice; no clinical thresholds are applied. Anomaly flags mark values that are statistically unusual relative to the subject's own baseline within one series, for human review. Simulated, measured and modeled values are analysed separately and never pooled.
notice.title: Notice

note.default: Statistically unusual relative to own baseline; for review. Not a clinical finding.
note.title: Note

BaselineSpec.description:
How the personal baseline of each series is chosen.

* ``first_n``: the first ``n`` analysed values of the series (time-ordered).
* ``time_window``: values with ``start <= observed_at < end``.

Defaults are engineering choices for exercising software, not scientific recommendations.
BaselineSpec.title: BaselineSpec

CommandStatusEvent.description: Append-only status history; the command record itself never changes.
CommandStatusEvent.title: CommandStatusEvent

DataOrigin.description: What kind of thing a value is. Never merge across origins implicitly.
DataOrigin.title: DataOrigin

total_count.description: Observations in this series before exclusions.
total_count.title: Total Count

uncertainty_known_count.description: Analysed values with a known uncertainty (others are unknown, not zero).
uncertainty_known_count.title: Uncertainty Known Count

DerivedValue.description: A value computed by a documented method. Always ``modeled`` by definition.

observed_at.description: Time of the input measurement(s) for single-event derived values.
observed_at.title: Observed At

uncertainty.description: Propagated standard uncertainty; None when any input's is unknown.
uncertainty.title: Uncertainty

DerivedValue.title: DerivedValue

detector_material.description: None = not stated by the source.
detector_material.title: Detector Material

location.description: Where the detector was, e.g. 'Mars surface (Gale crater)'.
location.title: Location

DeviceAssignment.description:
Which subject a device belongs to within a mission (append-only; the latest by
``assigned_at`` is current). ``subject_id=None`` unassigns the device.

Used by write authorization (D-032): a restricted principal may submit an observation with a
``device_id`` only if that device is currently assigned to the observation's subject.
DeviceAssignment.title: DeviceAssignment

EnvironmentalEvent.description:
Space-environment record (DONKI event/notice or a detector measurement such as MSL RAD).

Never linked to a subject's dose: there is deliberately no subject field, and
``applies_to_individual`` is fixed to False.
EnvironmentalEvent.title: EnvironmentalEvent

observed_counts.description: Observations inside the window, per data origin.
observed_counts.title: Observed Counts

HealthObservation.description:
One immutable observation of one metric for one subject at one time.

Observations are append-only. A correction is a *new* observation whose
``supersedes`` points at the old id; nothing is ever updated in place. The ``id``
is generated by the client (UUID) so offline creation and retried sync are idempotent.

device_id.description: Producing device. Always set for gateway telemetry; None for legacy/generated data.
device_id.title: Device Id

quality.description: Signal-quality verdict; non-valid is kept and flagged.

uncertainty.description: Standard uncertainty (1 sigma) in the observation's own unit. None = unknown (never 0 by default); 0 means known exact. Additive optional field (D-025): schema_version stays 1.
uncertainty.title: Uncertainty

unit.description: UCUM-style unit string. Must match the metric definition.
unit.title: Unit

HealthObservation.title: HealthObservation

notice.default: Live gateway view. Values labelled simulated are synthetic test signals, not astronaut data.
notice.title: Notice

context.description: Same keys as the metric's context.
context.title: Context

Mission.description: Mission context: anchors the time model (L±n / R±n) and scopes access (D-021, M5).

data_origin.description: simulated for demo missions; never invent a real mission.

return_at.description: None while the mission is ongoing.
return_at.title: Return At

Mission.title: Mission

notice.default: Descriptive statistics and documented calculations only. Not a diagnosis, not medical advice, and no clinical thresholds are applied. Values keep their data origin (simulated / measured / modeled).
notice.title: Notice

Provenance.description:
Where a value came from. Requirements depend on ``data_origin``:

* simulated: ``generator_version`` and ``seed`` required.
* measured:  ``source_ref`` required (instrument, dataset id, DOI or URL a human can
  resolve); ``generator_version`` forbidden.
* modeled:   ``method`` required (model/algorithm name and version);
  ``generator_version`` forbidden.

derived_from.description: Observation ids this value was computed from (modeled data).
derived_from.title: Derived From

source.description: System, instrument or dataset family that produced the value.
source.title: Source

source_ref.description: Resolvable reference: dataset accession, DOI, URL, instrument id.
source_ref.title: Source Ref

Provenance.title: Provenance

metric.description: Registered metric this relates to, if any.
metric.title: Metric

quantity.description: What the value describes, in the source's terms.
quantity.title: Quantity

source_identifier.description: DOI, PMID, NTRS id or dataset accession.
source_identifier.title: Source Identifier

Quality.description:
Signal-quality verdict attached by the producing device or gateway.

Provisional vocabulary (docs/DECISIONS.md D-016): the team may extend it. Non-valid
observations are stored, never silently dropped, and are flagged in summaries/UI.
Quality.title: Quality

RecurringTimepoints.description: Every ``every_days`` from (start_anchor + start_offset) to (end_anchor + end_offset), inclusive.
RecurringTimepoints.title: RecurringTimepoints

n.description: Sample size as reported; None if not reported.
n.title: N

ResolvedEvent.description: A planned measurement time. ``planned_at`` is modeled (derived from mission anchors).
ResolvedEvent.title: ResolvedEvent

ReturnNowCommand.description: RETURN_NOW is issued by a human only (D-021). MEDVITAL stores, syncs and displays it.
ReturnNowCommand.title: ReturnNowCommand

RuleConfig.description: Operational parameters (engineering defaults, not clinical or scientific values).
RuleConfig.title: RuleConfig

RuleFinding.description: Non-clinical, deterministic rule output. A review flag, never a diagnosis or risk label.
RuleFinding.title: RuleFinding

events_with_observations.description: Per data origin; origins are never pooled.
events_with_observations.title: Events With Observations

note.default: Coverage compares planned windows with recorded observations. Missing measurements stay missing: nothing is imputed or interpolated.
note.title: Note

unscheduled_observations.description: Matching observations outside every planned window, per data origin.
unscheduled_observations.title: Unscheduled Observations

SeriesKey.description: Everything that makes two values comparable. Values with different keys are never pooled.
SeriesKey.title: SeriesKey

disclaimer.default: Synthetic profile for software testing. Baseline values are arbitrary placeholders, not derived from any NASA dataset or real individual.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

persist.description: Also store the generated observations on the server.
persist.title: Persist

window_days.description: Tolerance either side of the planned day.
window_days.title: Window Days

SourceArtifact.description: Manifest of one downloaded source file. The file itself is stored unmodified, by checksum.

source_url.description: Retrieval URL with any API key removed.
source_url.title: Source Url

SourceArtifact.title: SourceArtifact

next_cursor.description: Pass as ?cursor= on the next pull.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

TelemetryBatch.description:
Raw event objects, validated one by one so a single bad event cannot block a batch.
The event shape is documented by ``GET /api/v1/telemetry/schema`` (``TelemetryEvent``).
TelemetryBatch.title: TelemetryBatch
